## Activity

During November 2025, River Outreach recorded 58 captures. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the month. It provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below. The activity total is presented without adjustment or extrapolation.

## Image quality

Of the 58 captures, 3 were ungradable. The reported ungradable rate was 5.2%. These images could not proceed to a grading outcome and are therefore reported separately from the referable results. The ungradable count and rate are included to support routine monitoring of image quality at River Outreach.

## Grading

Grading identified 8 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. Together, these measures describe the reported grading output for November 2025: 8 referable results, with a median lag of 1 day, alongside 3 ungradable captures. The figures should be read as the monthly results for River Outreach and are reported using the stated capture, image-quality and grading measures.
